# Priscilla Grant

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** poor  <sub>[v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c16 P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>; Prissy  <sub>[v3 c3 P14](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0014)</sub>; Pris  <sub>[v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012), [v3 c9 P6](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with golden, ethereal beauty. She stands roughly two inches taller than most of her peers.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Despite her ethereal appearance, Priscilla is full of mischief, pranks, and fun. She possesses a cheerful and resolute nature, often engaging in playful chatter to encourage her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c3 P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056)_

## History

Priscilla studied at Queen's Academy, where she formed a close circle of intimate friends with Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard. After graduating, she prepared to teach at her home school and participated in the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, for which she wrote a paper on cemeteries. Later, she gained her father's consent to attend Redmond College in Kingsport, boarding and studying classics alongside Anne Shirley, Philippa Gordon, and Stella Maynard at Patty's Place. After finishing her studies at Redmond, Priscilla married a handsome foreign missionary who praised her beauty, and the couple subsequently moved to Japan.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v4 c1 P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024), [v4 c3 P16](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0016)_
